questions.q: Which liberator, born in Caracas, freed much of South America?
questions.why: Venezuela's currency is named after him.

questions.q: In which year did Venezuela declare independence?
questions.why: It was declared on 5 July.

questions.q: Who was President of Venezuela from 1999 until his death in 2013?
questions.why: He called his movement the Bolivarian Revolution.

questions.q: Which explorer named Venezuela 'Little Venice'?
questions.why: Stilt houses reminded them of Venice.

questions.q: Which resource made Venezuela rich in the 1900s?
questions.why: It has the world's largest proven oil reserves.

questions.q: Which 1821 battle secured Venezuelan independence?
questions.why: Bolívar led the patriot army.

questions.q: Which precursor of independence led an early expedition in 1806?
questions.why: He fought in the American and French revolutions too.

questions.q: Which general became Venezuela's first President after it left Gran Colombia?
questions.why: He led the llaneros, plains cavalry.

questions.q: Which dictator ruled Venezuela from 1908 to 1935?
questions.why: Oil was discovered under his rule.

questions.q: Who succeeded Hugo Chávez as President?
questions.why: He had been a bus driver.

questions.q: Which Venezuelan opposition leader won the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: She was honoured for her fight for democracy.

questions.q: Which 1958 agreement began Venezuela's democratic era?
questions.why: Three parties agreed to share power.

questions.q: Which Venezuelan general won the decisive 1824 battle of Ayacucho?
questions.why: Bolivia's capital is named after him.

questions.q: Which teacher of Bolívar was a famous educator?
questions.why: He took Bolívar to Europe.

questions.q: Which scholar from Caracas wrote Chile's civil code?
questions.why: He also wrote a famous Spanish grammar.

questions.q: What is the capital of Venezuela?
questions.why: It lies in a mountain valley.

questions.q: Which waterfall in Venezuela is the world's highest?
questions.why: It drops 979 m.

questions.q: Which corn cakes are a Venezuelan staple?
questions.why: They are stuffed with cheese, meat or beans.

questions.q: What is Venezuela's currency?
questions.why: It is named after Simón Bolívar.

questions.q: Which river flows across Venezuela to the Atlantic?
questions.why: Its delta is huge.

questions.q: Which country has won the most Miss Universe titles after the USA?
questions.why: Beauty pageants are hugely popular.

questions.q: Which sport is the most popular in Venezuela?
questions.why: Many Venezuelans play in MLB.

questions.q: Which lake in the west is one of the oldest in the world and full of oil?
questions.why: Lightning strikes there almost every night.

questions.q: What are the flat-topped mountains of the Gran Sabana called?
questions.why: Mount Roraima is one of them.

questions.q: Which Christmas dish wraps meat in corn dough and banana leaves?
questions.why: Families make them together.

questions.q: Which Venezuelan baseball star won the Triple Crown in 2012?
questions.why: It was the first in 45 years.

questions.q: Which Venezuelan network of youth orchestras is world-famous?
questions.why: Conductor Gustavo Dudamel came from it.

questions.q: Which writer and President wrote 'Doña Bárbara'?
questions.why: A major literature prize is named after him.

questions.q: What is the name of the never-ending lightning storm over Lake Maracaibo?
questions.why: It can strike thousands of times an hour.

questions.q: What is Venezuela's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is about 4,978 m high.
